title: Vyaktitv: A Multimodal Peer-to-Peer Hindi Conversations based Dataset for Personality Assessment
base_benchmarks: Goldberg's Big Five factor structure markers
findings: Participants who self-identified as 'religious/culturally inclined' tended to have lower scores for Neuroticism, indicating higher emotional stability.
